items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: Bix Beiderbecke from drink; Bunny Berigan from drink.

ctx.x: Are there jazz people out there now that you would like to focus on with a film, or a group of them?

I think the last time I really was moved and wanted to do a film about a jazz person image was Clifford Brown. And that was twenty years ago. I really wanted to do that film, because I loved Clifford’s playing. And who he was as a man. He ran sort of counter to the prevailing jazz of the fifties, which was people who were debauched, they did heroin and you’d see people playing and nodding off while they’re playing. And he was a mathematician, he was a chess player, he was a clean liver, he was a beautiful, sweet…
